name: Baseline — NMC 13S10P, passive
description: Typical low-cost e-scooter pack: high-energy NMC 21700, plastic holders, sealed enclosure, 2 NTCs at the edge, 0.5C charge.

assumptions.text: Ambient 40 °C; ride starts at ambient; charger is plugged in immediately after the ride (pack still hot)
Drive profile is a synthetic repeating urban power cycle (not a homologation cycle)
Passive enclosure: effective h=2 W/m²K per cell surface, edge cells 2.5x better cooled
Cell-to-cell conductance 0.10 W/K through holders and busbars
Cell variation σ: capacity 1.5%, resistance 4% (fresh, unbinned cells)
Holder, busbar, enclosure, BMS masses and costs are placeholders
Ageing: datasheet cycle life scaled by Arrhenius on mean cell temperature only
